purpose: Skeleton-first foot audit. Test the user's observed oversized-foot issue against measurement-compatible adult male metatarsal/phalangeal radiographic data.

measurement_compatibility.metatarsals: Mixed evidence. Patil 2017 base-articular-midpoint→head lengths are closer to a003 semantics than whole-foot surface length, but stature-aware maximum-length studies predict much larger M1/M2 values at 1.82 m. These definitions/populations must be reconciled before any metatarsal is shortened.
measurement_compatibility.proximal_middle_phalanges: Moderate-to-strong. Patil uses articular-surface midpoint to midpoint; a003 uses joint/station endpoints.
measurement_compatibility.distal_phalanges: Weaker. a003 distal segments terminate at a tip station that may include soft tissue beyond the distal phalanx.

hallux_distal_phalanx.measurement_warning: a003 distal phalanx tail may extend to a surface/toe-tip station; direct osteometric equivalence is weaker than for metatarsals/proximal/middle phalanges.

toe2_distal_phalanx.measurement_warning: a003 distal phalanx tail may extend to a surface/toe-tip station; direct osteometric equivalence is weaker than for metatarsals/proximal/middle phalanges.

toe3_distal_phalanx.measurement_warning: a003 distal phalanx tail may extend to a surface/toe-tip station; direct osteometric equivalence is weaker than for metatarsals/proximal/middle phalanges.

toe4_distal_phalanx.measurement_warning: a003 distal phalanx tail may extend to a surface/toe-tip station; direct osteometric equivalence is weaker than for metatarsals/proximal/middle phalanges.

toe5_distal_phalanx.measurement_warning: a003 distal phalanx tail may extend to a surface/toe-tip station; direct osteometric equivalence is weaker than for metatarsals/proximal/middle phalanges.

findings: The surface-foot defect remains confirmed: a003 heel-to-toe skin length is ~305 mm versus a stature-conditioned ANSUR expectation of ~280 mm (z ≈ +2.77). The existing model therefore is visibly and quantitatively long-footed.

The earlier inference that all five metatarsal bones are definitely too long is withdrawn. Patil 2017 gives substantially shorter unconditioned male means, but stature-aware Spanish/Portuguese forensic equations predict M1/M2 lengths close to a003 for a 1.82 m adult.

At 1.82 m, the Spain M1 equation predicts ~78.2 mm versus a003 ~72.6 mm; the Portugal M2 equation predicts ~88.1 mm versus a003 ~86.4 mm. Those differences are small enough that automatic metatarsal shortening would be unjustified.
Toe phalanges still appear long versus the Patil sample, but no stature-conditioned toe-phalange source has yet confirmed the magnitude. They stay REOPEN rather than marked wrong.

The correct skeleton-first conclusion is therefore: the old foot mesh is definitely too long, while the internal distribution of length across hindfoot, midfoot, metatarsals, toes and terminal soft tissue is unresolved and must be rebuilt from compatible sources before the mesh is shortened.

provisional_target_corridors_mm.note: Patil 2017 bands are retained as one radiographic evidence set, not as frozen canonical corridors. Stature-aware maximum-length studies conflict materially and must be mapped to the same endpoints before target selection.

next_steps: Map the Spain/Portugal/Korea metatarsal maximum-length definitions against HGPT TMT-base→MTP-head landmarks before changing any metatarsal.
Find a stature-aware or endpoint-compatible source for M3-M5 and toe phalanges.
Derive hindfoot/midfoot joint-to-joint targets separately; current tarsal control sticks are not whole-bone lengths.
Partition final heel-to-toe length into calcaneal posterior allowance + hindfoot/midfoot + metatarsals + phalanges + terminal soft tissue, then shorten the mesh around that canonical chain.
Do not implement the earlier Patil-only metatarsal shortening.

stature_conditioned_crosscheck.interpretation: These stature regressions use maximum/osteometric/radiographic metatarsal definitions and different populations. They show that the earlier Patil-mean comparison cannot by itself prove that a003 metatarsals are pathologically long: at 1.82 m, independent equations imply substantially longer M1/M2 values than the Patil sample means and values near or above the a003 spans.

audit_correction_2026_10_08.reason: A second evidence pass added stature-aware metatarsal regressions. They materially conflict with the earlier unconditioned radiographic means and show a003 M1/M2 can be plausible for 1.82 m stature.
audit_correction_2026_10_08.correction: Withdraw 'skeletal foot defect confirmed' for metatarsal lengths. Keep only the surface-foot length defect as confirmed; internal bone-chain lengths remain open.
audit_correction_2026_10_08.safety: No production or audit geometry was changed.

stature_aware_crosscheck.reading: Stature-aware forensic studies using maximum/physiological metatarsal lengths predict substantially longer bones for a 1.82 m adult than the unconditioned Patil sample means. A003 M1 and M2 are close to the Spain/Portugal stature predictions, so the earlier claim that the metatarsals themselves are definitively oversized is not supported.
